CAUSE: The live database is not behind. The MCP subprocess is opening the checkout’s default `data/orchestra.db` because its launch environment drops `ORCHESTRA_DB_PATH`.

In [db.py](/home/kesha/bench906/runs/A-T3-luna-r1/app/db.py:21), `_resolve_db_path()` uses `ORCHESTRA_DB_PATH` when present and otherwise selects the checkout’s default file. `init_db()` raises the reported error when that file has an existing schema it does not recognize at [db.py](/home/kesha/bench906/runs/A-T3-luna-r1/app/db.py:67).

The propagation gap is in [runtime_env.py](/home/kesha/bench906/runs/A-T3-luna-r1/app/runtime_env.py:17): `MCP_BASE_ENV` forwards proxy and auth variables but omits `ORCHESTRA_DB_PATH`. [manager.py](/home/kesha/bench906/runs/A-T3-luna-r1/app/manager.py:363) builds the MCP environment from that allowlist. The stdio server then calls `init_db()` during `codex_review` in [mcp_stdio.py](/home/kesha/bench906/runs/A-T3-luna-r1/app/mcp_stdio.py:4023).

Recommend adding `ORCHESTRA_DB_PATH` to the MCP subprocess environment propagation, then reconnecting/restarting the MCP client so it inherits the configured database path. Do not migrate the live database based on this error.
